title: Swapping for a well's third token costs nothing
rootCause: Stable2.calcReserve reads only the first two reserves, so in a well with a third token the amount a swap must pay in does not move however much of that token is taken out, and Well.swapTo charges nothing for it.

poc.observable: test_taking_the_third_token_out_costs_something fails with "what the swap takes in for the third token: 0 <= 0"
